scope: Single guest-process multimedia timer resolution profile over native CLOCK_MONOTONIC and nanosleep; no callback/event timer implementation or scheduler latency guarantee.
minimum: ceil(clock_getres(CLOCK_MONOTONIC) nanoseconds / 1000000); invalid or unavailable resolution returns TIMERR_NOCANDO
oversized_buffers: write only the two UINT fields; sizes >=8 accepted
periods: Balanced per-period references with synchronized updates. Native clock and finite delays already use their finest available representation, independent of period requests. No global host timer adjustment.
compatibility_note: 65535ms is a declared compatibility ceiling, not a measured Darwin maximum. The native resolution is queried rather than copied from a Windows machine.
